title: The Armorer
description: The Armorer led a covert of Mandalorians strictly adherent to the Mandalorian creed. They found a home on Nevarro for a time but were forced to abandon it. They eventually rallied around Bo-Katan Kryze and helped take back their home of Mandalore. The Armorer's magnetic tongs and gravity hammer made her capable behind the forge of a cryo-furnace.
